blocks.head: alt Either user invites the other user
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt UserX has key and the device exists
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt The cloud has a membership record for UserX and UserY exists

state_rules.rule:
eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (Members , UserY) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , UserX : ('members' : Members , ....) , .....) > 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ....) , UserY : ('device' : Device , ...) , UserX : ('members' : Members , ....) , .....) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : nils , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | (Device) 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('key' : randomStr('KeyA', N) , ...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ....) , .....) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' Device | (randomStr('KeyA', N)) .

eq < deviceA | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceA | (Key) 
= < deviceA | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('key' : ExistingKey , ..) > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceA | (Key) 
= < deviceA | ('key' : ExistingKey , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : Key , 'trusted' : Trusted , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' deviceA | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : Key , 'trusted' : (Trusted , UserX) , ...) > .

eq < deviceA | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'power' : 'off' , ..) > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'power' : 'on' , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA | (deviceA) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ..) , ...) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA .

eq < deviceA | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'power' : 'off' , ..) > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'power' : 'on' , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , RemainingMembers) , ..) , UserY : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : RemainingMembers , ....) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ....) , .....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ....) , .....) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ....) , .....) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < Device | (...) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Device) @ S < UserX | (..) > < Device | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceA | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceA | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .

event_rules.label: rev6
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev6]: E @ S < UserY | (..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ....) > 
=> ep: ev6(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserY | (..) > < cloudA | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ....) > .
